text.std: I’m {name}. Today is my first visit to the dentist.
text.easy: I’m {name}. Today is my first visit to the dentist.

noName.std: Today is my first visit to the dentist.
noName.easy: Today is my first visit to the dentist.

pages.alt: Illustration: I’m the child. Today is my first visit to the dentist.

text.std: I pack Fern, my soft green rabbit. Mom says Fern can come with us.
text.easy: I pack Fern, my soft green rabbit. Mom says Fern can come with us.

pages.alt: Illustration: I pack Fern, my soft green rabbit. Mom says Fern can come with us.

text.std: We walk up to a big glass door. This is the dentist’s office.
text.easy: We walk up to a big glass door. This is the dentist’s office.

pages.alt: Illustration: We walk up to a big glass door. This is the dentist’s office.

text.std: I stop to look through the door. Mom waits with me until I’m ready.
text.easy: I stop to look through the door. Mom waits with me until I’m ready.

pages.alt: Illustration: I stop to look through the door. Mom waits with me until I’m ready.

text.std: At the desk, Mom tells someone my name.
text.easy: At the desk, Mom tells someone my name.

pages.alt: Illustration: At the desk, Mom tells someone my name.

text.std: I can wave, say hello, or stay close to Mom.
text.easy: I can wave, say hello, or stay close to Mom.

text.easy: We might wait a little. I sit right next to Mom.

text.easy: I squeeze Fern’s soft ears while we wait for my name.

text.std: “Hi, {name},” the dentist says. It’s my turn.

text.std: The dentist shows us where to go. Mom comes with me.
text.easy: The dentist shows us where to go. Mom comes with me.

pages.alt: Illustration: The dentist shows us where to go. Mom comes with me.

text.std: There’s a chair that can lean back. I can ask how it works.
text.easy: There’s a chair that can lean back. I can ask how it works.

text.std: There’s a light above the chair so the dentist can see my teeth.
text.easy: There’s a light above the chair so the dentist can see my teeth.

pages.alt: Illustration: There’s a light above the chair so the dentist can see my teeth.

text.std: I put on a paper bib. The dentist shows me a little mirror.
text.easy: I put on a paper bib. The dentist shows me a little mirror.

text.easy: The mirror helps the dentist see the teeth hiding in the back.

text.std: A little tube can slurp up water. The dentist shows me how it sounds.
text.easy: A little tube can slurp up water. The dentist shows me how it sounds.

text.std: I can try my headphones if the sound bothers me.

text.easy: I raise my hand to ask for a pause. The dentist puts her tool down.
